auth.label: Session
auth.doc: Selects whether the prototype represents a partner with an active session or a signed-out visitor.

in.label: Signed in
in.doc: Shows the partner workspace and keeps navigation between operational screens available.

out.label: Signed out
out.doc: Shows the authentication boundary instead of exposing partner data.

access.label: Access
access.doc: Pins the permission level used to demonstrate available, read-only and inaccessible partner operations.

full.label: Full access
full.doc: Shows editing and decision actions for an authorized partner account.

read.label: Read only
read.doc: Keeps operational data visible while disabling mutations.

none.label: No access
none.doc: Hides protected operations and explains that the current account lacks access.

connection.label: Inventory connection
connection.doc: Selects whether room availability is maintained directly or supplied by a connected channel manager.

manual.label: Manual
manual.doc: Allows availability to be edited in the partner app when permissions permit it.

chm.label: Channel manager
chm.doc: Makes availability read-only in the app because the active channel manager is the inventory source.

density.label: Information density
density.doc: Changes presentation density without changing the underlying records or business rules.

compact.label: Compact
compact.doc: Uses a calmer summary layout for quick scanning.

dense.label: Dense
dense.doc: Shows more operational detail at once for routine partner work.

inv.label: Demo inventory
inv.doc: Pins the amount of fixture inventory available in lists and summaries.

many.label: Many records
many.doc: Shows a populated operational day with several items to review.

some.label: Some records
some.doc: Shows a shorter queue while preserving normal navigation and actions.

none.label: No records
none.doc: Shows the explicit empty state instead of placeholder rows.

hotel.label: Property mode
hotel.doc: Selects an active property or a test property used for demonstration and training.

active.label: Active property
active.doc: Uses the SPA HOTEL ČAJKOVSKIJ demo package fixture.

test.label: Test property
test.doc: Clearly labels a non-live property so prototype actions cannot be mistaken for live operations.

usecases.name: Start the operational day
usecases.story: A fully authorized hotel partner opens the dashboard, reviews the current workload and moves into reservations or inventory management.
rules: Dashboard links preserve the selected demo state when they open operational screens.
The populated fixture is deterministic across Czech and English app screens.

usecases.name: Review a shorter queue
usecases.story: A partner switches to the compact presentation while working through a smaller set of reservations.
rules: Density changes presentation only; reservation identity and amounts remain unchanged.
The selected reservation opens the same detail record from each queue presentation.

usecases.name: Understand an empty reservations view
usecases.story: A partner opens reservations for a period with no matching records and gets a purposeful next step instead of an empty table shell.
rules: The empty state must not fabricate reservation rows.
Filters remain available so the partner can broaden the search.

usecases.name: Inspect data without edit permission
usecases.story: A read-only user reviews reservations, rates and billing while every operation that would mutate data remains unavailable.
rules: Read-only access keeps source data visible and disables mutation controls.
Billing approval and dispute are exposed only to accounts that satisfy the corresponding backend authorization checks.

usecases.name: Reach the authentication and permission boundary
usecases.story: A signed-out visitor or an account without property access sees no protected hotel information and a clear recovery path.
rules: Protected partner data is not rendered when the session or access requirement is not met.
The test-property label remains visible wherever it prevents confusion about live operations.

usecases.name: Check channel-managed availability
usecases.story: A hotel connected to a channel manager reviews room availability while the partner app prevents conflicting manual changes.
rules: An active channel-manager connection makes availability editing unavailable in this app.
The page still presents the selected date range and room-day values for review.

usecases.name: Maintain an offer and its rate
usecases.story: A partner reviews the demo package fixture, then moves to the related price configuration without losing context.
rules: The demo fixture stays consistent within the prototype: SPA HOTEL ČAJKOVSKIJ, three days, two nights, from 3,577 CZK, check-in 14:00 and check-out 10:00.
Offer and rate actions respect the selected access level.

usecases.name: Approve or dispute a billing line
usecases.story: An authorized account reviews a confirmed reservation and chooses either approval or a dispute supported by a reason and a corrected positive amount.
rules: Approval and dispute require an authorized account.
A dispute requires a reason and a positive price; the prototype demonstrates validation without making a backend write.
